To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) a minimum of 800 SNP are needed to accurately predict the parentage of animals at a ≤1 % misconcordance rate, 2) the ICBF800 panel is an effective set of SNPs to use for this purpose, and 3) we present a novel pipeline to deal with sample and SNP QC issues that arise from genotyping a large national herd.

we have developed a SNP QC and Animal QC pipeline to handle the challenges of a large cattle population with high genotype density that is used for parentage validation, identification, and prediction.
the ICBF800 panel is a robust SNP set for parentage validation and identification in a Bos taurus national population.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the use of high density SNP genotypes for parentage and genomic identification in large populations.
the quality control of SNP and genomic samples in a large national herd and the application of this to parentage verification and animal identification.
SNP QC, genomic sample QC, and parentage prediction in a national cattle population.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
ICBF800 panel provides highly accurate SNP-based parentage verification and animal identification in a national cattle population.
the ICBF SNP QC and animal QC pipelines are highly effective in detecting and correcting errors in the data and in identifying animals that do not belong to the herd.

the ICBF SNP QC pipeline is a robust and accurate method of identifying genotyping errors, and that the ICBFSNP QC pipeline can be used as an example of how to develop a QC pipeline in any cattle population.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the ICBF SNP QC and parentage pipelines are a robust, efficient, and highly accurate method for QC of large SNP datasets and parentage verification in a national herd.

we have developed an efficient SNP based parentage pipeline to handle the unique challenges of a large national herd and have demonstrated that a highly accurate SNP set can be developed for a national herd.
we have developed a SNP and animal QC pipeline that can be used in a national herd and that is highly accurate and computationally efficient.
The main takeaway from our work is that
SNP QC alone is not enough and that a genomic sample QC is required to identify errors that can arise from a national herd.

the use of a large SNP set such as ICBF800 can greatly enhance the accuracy of the parentage prediction and identification process and that the use of an SNP set that is not optimized for a particular breed or population can be used for parentage validation and identification.
the SNP and sample QC pipeline is essential to ensure the highest level of parentage and genomic prediction accuracy.
